model_system: Kagome metal near van Hove singularities, motivated by AV3Sb5 (A=K,Rb,Cs), using a 3-patch single-orbital kagome model with 3Q imaginary CDW (orbital current) and singlet superconductivity

key_params.orbitals: single d-orbital approximation on V sites
key_params.dispersion_near_vHS: epsilon1=(t/2) kx (kx+sqrt(3) ky), epsilon2=-(t/4)(kx^2-3ky^2), epsilon3=(t/2) kx (kx-sqrt(3) ky)
key_params.iCDW_order: Phi_{alpha,sigma}=(|I_iCDW|/Lambda^2) sum_k epsilon_{alpha beta gamma}<c^dagger_{gamma k sigma} c_{beta k sigma}>
key_params.SC_order: Delta_alpha=(|I_SC|/Lambda^2) sum_k <c_{alpha k down} c_{alpha,-k up}>
key_params.quartic_coefficients: u1 ~= (0.003/tT^2) log(t Lambda^2/T), u2 ~= 0.006/(tT^2), with u1 >> u2 favoring 3Q-iCDW

headline_claim: For the 4 possible 3Q iCDW patterns, the spin-resolved total Chern numbers are C_up=+1 for all and C_down = +1, -1, -1, +1 respectively; thus only pattern (ii) is helical and time-reversal symmetric while the others are TR-breaking.
replication_difficulty: medium — mostly analytic/symmetry-based LG derivation plus simple tight-binding band/Chern-number checks, but reproducing coefficients and topology consistently requires care.
